title: Kindly Velvety Egyptian Lentil Tagine
description: A fresh and velvety one-pot Egyptian dish featuring garlic and lentils, cooked to perfection in a tagine, vegan-friendly and delicious.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant and lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and cook, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the red lentils, vegetable broth, and 1 cup of water, and bring to a boil.
Cover the tagine or Dutch oven and transfer it to the oven, where it will cook, covered, at 300 degrees Fahrenheit for 30 minutes.
Remove the tagine or Dutch oven from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
